note: All 10 pages on sealines.eu returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to WebFetch (both IT and EN versions). Page content analysis is derived from Google search index snippets, cached descriptions, and title tags visible in SERPs. Word counts, H1/H2 inventories, and FAQ detection could NOT be performed directly due to bot-blocking. Findings below reflect what is observable externally.
critical_site_wide_problems: HTTP 403 returned to all automated fetchers — aggressive bot-blocking may also block search engine renderers or SEO audit tools
Many Italian-language pages (e.g. /traghetti-grecia, /traghetti-sardegna, /traghetti-sicilia, /traghetti-croazia) show '2025' in Google's indexed title tags as of May 2026 — stale year references
Duplicate URL structures: Italian pages exist at both /traghetti-grecia AND /index.php/traghetti-grecia AND /en/destinations/direct/ferries-greece/ — potential duplicate content / cannibalization
Title tags use pipe separators inconsistently: some use '|' (e.g. 'Traghetti | Sealines Prenota Traghetti 2025'), others do not
sealines.eu does NOT appear in the top 10 search results for any of the major target keywords tested (traghetti grecia, traghetti sardegna, traghetti sicilia, biglietti traghetti)
Multiple pages still display '2025' in titles when competitors already show '2026'

keyword_volumes.note: Exact monthly search volumes are not publicly available through web search — they require paid SEO tool access (Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Keyword Planner). Estimates below are based on industry knowledge for Italian travel keywords.
keyword_volumes.traghetti_grecia: Estimated 40,000-90,000/month (highly seasonal, peak June-August). One of the highest-volume ferry keywords in Italy.
keyword_volumes.traghetti_sardegna: Estimated 60,000-110,000/month (highly seasonal, peak June-September). Likely the highest-volume Italian ferry keyword.
keyword_volumes.jadrolinija: Estimated 10,000-20,000/month (brand keyword, lower in IT market).
keyword_volumes.data_source: Estimates based on Italian travel keyword benchmarks. No verified Semrush/Ahrefs data was obtainable via public web search.
